name: com.grantsights/grantsights
title: GrantSights
description: Search US grants with their official eligibility evidence; rank private foundations from 990-PFs.

tools.name: search_grants
tools.description: Finds public funding records by program name, notice number, Assistance Listing number, or topic. Results include sources and date roles for open calls, standing programs, forecasts, and closed records. Search does not establish applicant eligibility.

query.description: Public grant name, topic, notice number, or Assistance Listing number with at least three letters or a numeric listing code.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same search and filters.

include_catalog_close.description: Includes catalog close dates for comparison. Verified agency expiration has a separate source.

state.description: US state name or two-letter code. Excludes explicitly different state programs; federal records and records with unknown service geography can remain. Inclusion is not confirmed geographic eligibility.

county.description: Optional county name, for example Duval County. Requires state and limits results to checked records explicitly naming the county. A match does not establish eligibility.

deadline_from.description: Earliest confirmed application date, inclusive. Records without a confirmed date are excluded.

tools.name: get_grant
tools.description: Reads one public grant by its exact GrantSights ID or slug. Returns quoted eligibility evidence, applicant classes, funding amounts, application dates, notice expiration, source links, and freshness. Cutoff times and time zones are included when supported by the record for the relevant application track.

grant_id.description: Exact GrantSights public grant ID or slug. Notice numbers and arbitrary URLs are not accepted as grant IDs.

include_catalog_close.description: Includes the catalog close date for comparison with application and agency dates.

tools.name: open_grant_review
tools.description: Reads one public grant by its exact GrantSights ID or slug and opens a blank applicant fit form in hosts that support the interactive view. Returns public evidence without running an assessment, storing applicant facts, or submitting an application.

grant_id.description: Exact GrantSights public grant ID or slug. Notice numbers and arbitrary URLs are not accepted as grant IDs.

include_catalog_close.description: Includes the catalog close date for comparison with application and agency dates.

tools.name: assess_grant_fit
tools.description: Checks one exact public grant against applicant facts supplied or confirmed for this assessment. Returns apply, review, watch, or skip with reasons, blockers, missing facts, quoted eligibility evidence, and the date for the specified application track when known. Does not estimate award probability or submit an application.

applicant_subtype.description: Applicant's confirmed legal class. An absent value or not_sure represents an unknown class.

state.description: Applicant state explicitly supplied or confirmed for this assessment.

funding_area.description: Applicant's project topic supplied or confirmed for this assessment.

funding_min.description: Minimum project funding amount confirmed by the applicant for this assessment.

funding_max.description: Maximum project funding amount confirmed by the applicant for this assessment.

readiness.description: Registration and readiness facts confirmed by the applicant for this assessment.

prior_funding_from_this_funder.description: Confirmed prior funding from the funder of this exact grant. An absent value represents unknown funding history with this funder.

applicant.description: Confirmed applicant facts relevant to this assessment. Names, emails, documents, and private identifiers are outside the input scope.

application_type.description: Defaults to new. Different application types can have different due dates.

tools.name: find_organization
tools.description: Finds a US nonprofit by name or EIN in a state, from the IRS exempt organizations file. Returns up to 8 matches with EIN, city, cause and budget band.

name.description: The organization's name, or its 9-digit EIN.

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, for example OH.

tools.name: find_funders
tools.description: Ranks the private foundations most likely to fund a US nonprofit, from their 990-PF giving. Takes the organization's EIN, or its state and causes. Returns how many foundations passed every check and the top 3, each with its fit, why, whether it takes requests (with the filing year and any dated website check), how to apply from its filing, and recent grants to similar groups. Quote the filing years and check dates. A past grant shows what a foundation funded, not that it accepts requests now or that this organization is eligible; never promise funding.

ein.description: The organization's 9-digit EIN from find_organization. State and causes come from the IRS file unless passed.

state.description: US state name or two-letter code. Required without an EIN.

causes.description: Up to 3 causes. Required without an EIN.

zip.description: Optional 5-digit ZIP, to favor foundations that gave nearby.

tools.name: get_funder
tools.description: One private foundation's public summary from its 990-PF filings: whether it takes requests, with the source year and any dated website check, total giving and its years, and its newest grant. A past grant shows what a foundation funded, not that it accepts requests now or that this organization is eligible; never promise funding.
